newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac to give television interview Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to give television interview Thursday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will give a television interview on Thursday evening, an official source said on Monday.
Plans for the television appearance this week had been widely leaked to the French press.
Speculation has been running high for several weeks that Chirac was preparing a television appearance to bolster the government's flagging popularity.
He last addressed French people on television in a July 14 interview.
